reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount like the other providers, but the download side copies downloadAkahuTransactions instead of factoring a shared single-account download.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions/downloadPluggyAiTransactions (token, post, error mapping, response shaping), and linkFintegraAccount mirrors linkAkahuAccount; the copying follows a pattern already present in the tree.

placement.why: Each piece sits where its provider siblings live: link handler and registration in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, base URL in server-config.ts, account type in types/models.

scope.why: Only what a new server-side provider needs, plus a release note.

maintainability.why: Consistent with how the other providers are wired, so easy to follow; adds one more copy of the per-provider download boilerplate to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses linkBankSyncAccount and the existing sync dispatch; no shared download abstraction exists to go around.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied download function keeps the same shape as its siblings; it is open, not disguised.
